name: Taro
source:
"I want to stay... in this 'mansion'..."

The protagonist of the game. He is pretty timid and looks like a girl due to his delicate features. As one could guess from his appearance, Taro has a shy personality, not to mention he is a mediocre student with few to no friends. One day, his life goes upside down as he falls in love at first sight with [url=/c34819]Shiro[/url], who makes him to move into the mansion where the four sisters live. After this, he stops going to school, and his bizarre life in the mansion starts.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=629165]Getchu[/url]]
